Create one administrator-owned `SpaceDomainReporterBinding` per reporter principal. The binding name is `reporter-<first-32-hex-of-SHA256(trimmed-principal))>`. The binding declares the exact domain, allowed kinds, exact peer domains, and a key in `kube-system/space-compute-reporter-public-keys`.\n2. Provision the webhook serving Secret `kube-system/space-compute-reporter-webhook-tls` for `space-compute-reporter-webhook.kube-system.svc`, apply `reporter-admission-webhook.yaml`, and inject the issuing CA into `ValidatingWebhookConfiguration/space-compute-reporter-truth`. Do not grant reporter writes until `/readyz` is healthy and the CA bundle is correct.\n3. Reporter object names are deterministic: summary `domain-<hash>`, directed link `link-<hash>`, transfer receipt `transfer-<hash>`, result receipt `result-<hash>`. The hash is the first 16 bytes of SHA-256 over the normalized identity used by the exported Go helpers in `contrib/space-compute/pkg/apis/v1alpha1`.\n4. Canonical provenance uses `spacecompute-canonical-v1`. Timestamps are UTC RFC3339Nano, field order is fixed, set/map-like values are sorted explicitly, and `provenance.digest` plus `provenance.signature` are excluded from the canonical payload.
